title: fix(app-shell): the generic metadata editor renders a view's served schema (a top-level anyOf), and a scalar-arm repeater draws scalar rows (objectui#11251, objectui#10239)
body:
Fixes #11251
Fixes #10239
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

Studio → object → Related → Views → a row opens `MetadataDetailDrawer`, which mounts `MetadataResourceEditPage` embedded; with no canvas there, the page renders the generic `SchemaForm` over the served `view` schema. That schema is the server's derivation of `ViewMetadataSchema`: a top-level `anyOf` over the stored shapes (ViewItem record, `defineView` container, list overlay, form overlay) with no top-level `properties`. `SchemaFormBody` read only `effectiveSchema.properties ?? {}`, so every stored view opened an editor with zero controls.

## The fix

1. **`SchemaFormBody` resolves a top-level `anyOf` / `oneOf` against the value with the existing `resolveUnionBranch`** (the resolver `repeaterItemSchema` and `resolveFieldFace` already use). No second resolver. A schema that declares its own `properties` beside a union is left alone.
2. **Two refinements inside `resolveUnionBranch`, because the obvious call lands the stored views on the wrong member.** Measured on the installed spec 17.5.0 with the unextended scorer: a ViewItem resolved to the list overlay, a flattened list overlay carrying `type: 'grid'` resolved to the FORM overlay, and a container resolved to the list overlay. The ViewItem case is the harmful one: its form would show the columns under `config` as an empty top-level `columns`, and `ViewMetadataSchema.safeParse` of that ViewItem plus a top-level `columns` / `type` edit answers `success: true` with branch `viewItem` and those keys stripped, so the edit would be dropped silently. The refinements:
   - `unionMembers`: a member that is itself a bare union (no `type`, no `properties`) is scored member by member. The ViewItem arm is `{ oneOf: [list ViewItem, form ViewItem] }` and scored zero as one member.
   - `valueContradictions`: among members that fit the value's kind, the one the value contradicts least wins: a key a closed member does not declare, a primitive outside a `const` / `enum`, a `required` key the value lacks. An empty value contradicts nothing (create mode still lands on the first member). Where contradictions tie, ranking is the old score in the old order.
3. **objectui#10239's scalar-arm guard, carried as triage bound it.** `RepeaterField` draws one scalar control per row when its items resolve to a scalar arm and the value has rows; Add appends a scalar. Before, a string-array `columns` row got the form's 14 object sub-fields, the card summary read `String.prototype.link`, and editing wrote `{"0":"n","1":"a","2":"m","3":"e","field":"title"}`. With no rows the first arm wins by order alone, so the empty value keeps its object-row first Add.

The curated designer (`VIEW_CURATED_FIELDS`, `FORM_FIELDS_OWNED_ELSEWHERE`, `ViewVariantInspector.tsx`) is untouched.

## Measured through the real page

jsdom, the real `MetadataDetailDrawer` → `MetadataResourceEditPage` (embedded), the mocked client serving `z.toJSONSchema(ViewMetadataSchema, { unrepresentable: 'any' })` + `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY.view`. Not run in a browser. Before = base `54a78308a`, after = `4a9380847`, same probe, form controls counted by scoped `mdf-drawer-metadata.` id after clicking Edit:

| stored shape | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| ViewItem | 0 | 2 (`name`, `label`) |
| list overlay | 0 | 11, including 2 scalar `columns` rows |
| container | 0 | 2 (`name`, `label`) |
| control: `ListViewSchema` served | 9 ids, 2 column rows | the same 9 ids, 2 column rows |

## Pins — `SchemaForm.topLevelUnion-11251.test.tsx`

- Served `view` schema through the real drawer: each of the three stored shapes renders controls, and not the wrong member's (ViewItem: no top-level `type` / `columns` / `searchableFields`; list overlay: `searchableFields` and the `columns` group, which the form overlay lacks; container: none of the list overlay's).
- Control: `ListViewSchema` served renders its list form with two object column rows.
- objectui#10239, through `SchemaForm` over `ListViewSchema` (top-level `properties`, so independent of the union step): a string-array `columns` stays strings `ListViewSchema` accepts, the row control is named by the host label plus its ordinal, Add appends `''`; object rows keep their declared fields; the empty value's first Add gives an object row.

## Ablations (committed HEAD `2082cb00b`, mutations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with anchor hit and blob change proven, each restore proven `blob == HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` empty; the test imports `./SchemaForm` from source, so no build leg)

| leg | mutation | red |
|---|---|---|
| A | drop the top-level resolution | exactly the three view rows (3 failed / 5 passed) |
| B | drop the scalar-row guard | exactly the string-array row (1 / 7) |
| C1 | drop the contradiction ranking | the list overlay row (1 / 7) |
| C2 | drop the bare-union flattening | the ViewItem row (1 / 7) |

## Gates

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over all 368 test files under `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`, in 7 chunks at `4a9380847`: 368 files passed, 4346 tests passed, 1 skipped. SchemaForm consumers outside it (studio-design panels, console `FormPage.sectionGroup`): 6 files, 20 tests passed.
- At `2082cb00b` (it differs from `4a9380847` by comment text, one test name and changeset prose): the pin file 8/8; the 43 `SchemaForm.*` / `ResourceEditPage.*` / `EmbeddedItemEditor.*` files, 413 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (closure built first): exit 0 at `4a9380847`; `tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new pin file.
- At `2082cb00b`: `pnpm exec eslint` on both changed files 0 errors (16 warnings, all on unchanged lines); `check-changeset-presence` ✅; `check-control-bytes` ✅; `check:new-line-citations` 0 new.

## Acceptance notes

- The served `viewForm` describes the flattened list shape only. A ViewItem or a container therefore renders its identity controls (`name`, `label`) plus the form's "declared in form layout but missing from schema" notice for the rest (8 each in the drawer). The ViewItem's list config under `config` is not editable through this door. Observation; the form registry is objectstack's. Carrier: none.
- In the served JSON, the overlays' `z.undefined()` refusals of `config` and the container slots derive to `{}` (accepts anything), so the served document cannot tell those refusals from free keys. The resolver separates container from overlay through the overlays' required `object` + `viewKind` pair instead. Observation only.
- Resolver reach beyond `view`: across the installed spec's served derivations (34 derived documents, both io modes), bare nested unions occur only at the `view` top level and at the `visible` / `disabled` predicate slots of `action` and object actions (input derivation), which render through the registered condition widget. No union member lacks `type` while carrying `required`. One-time scan; nothing re-derives it.
- A mixed `columns` array whose FIRST row is an object still draws object rows for every row. No valid stored view carries one: both arms refuse a mixed array at save.

Implemented by the `domain:ui` seat 2 dev run, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`.
